scope: data-only audit; no site/app/source-package/test edits; no record merges/deletions/new product IDs

inputs.evidenceBoundary: This audit verifies the supplied JSON snapshot and its recorded source citations, not a fresh PDF/web transcription.

groupingRules.text: Use actual familyId for every variant and the existing id for each family. For legacy references group navigation only by category + sourceUrl + series. Never use sourceFamilyId or photoSourceFamilyKey as a substitute for the actual parent graph.
Resolve children by their familyId; the stored parent variantIds omits 20 valid variants. Keep original links intact and add a separately derived complete child index.

Scope marking/model groups inside the true family. Keep all exact catalog markings. Use source-backed power/rating as an additional model dimension when the marking is generic. A shared power alone never makes distinct codes the same model.

Treat original row IDs as preserved evidence identities. Show real differences using voltage sides/classes, winding power vector, current, construction/winding material, connection, loss class or exact source execution wording. Never use an invented code or ID suffix as a customer-facing distinction.

Family → model → execution is a navigation projection, not a requirement to fabricate three layers. Families with no explicit child model keep their configuration tables nested. One model row may have no separate execution.

Only a configuration.modelId explicitly connects a configuration to a model. A null/missing modelId stays family-scoped. 36 variants contain complete inherited family arrays; their presence does not make every option a property of that variant.
Do not explode voltage lists, winding connection alternatives, code-option ranges, dimensional groups, or independent current/type lists into new product IDs or infer a complete compatibility matrix.
Keep original facts, units, unknowns, contradictions, page citations and configs. Display labels may clarify but cannot silently repair a disputed source code or unit.

Same short name, same normalized name, identical technical signatures, or shared source page does not prove an exact duplicate. Keep differing codes, families, executions and source provenance; merge requires explicit source identity evidence.
All 829 PDF-derived records explicitly say isOrderableSku=false; 14 legacy references omit it. Catalog model/variant/family are evidence kinds, not verified orderable SKUs.
